topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: The rain's been coming down all day, painting the streets in its usual greasy sheen. Got a delivery at my door, a vase with flowers, nothing else. No note, no card, just a bunch of blooms that look like they're trying to smile. I run a finger along the cold, frosted glass of the vase, my other hand never straying too far from the small revolver in the drawer. The phone's been quiet today, but I know it's just a matter of time before it rings, and it won't be good news. The flowers, they're a message, sure as hell, but who's talking and what's the word? I don't like surprises, not in this city. Not when the rain's like this.
